description: Capabilities granted to the Every Day window. Deliberately narrow: the webview has no network permission at all and its content security policy allows no outbound connection, so nothing it renders -- an entry, a task, or an event fetched from a subscribed calendar -- can cause a request. The only socket in the application is in the Rust shell (see src/feeds.rs), it is opened only for a calendar feed the user pasted in, and it is unreachable from here.
